prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph taken on a cheap compact camera with harsh on-camera flash, Kodak Gold 800 film grain, slightly crooked framing. A cramped basement recording studio at night. Before them a floor-to-ceiling wall of steel shelving crammed with thousands of reel-to-reel tape boxes and cassettes, each with a scruffy masking-tape label in black marker. Most labels are too small to read; three near the men read clearly: FINAL, FINAL FINAL, FINAL v847 USE THIS ONE. Flash falls off into darkness above. No other text, no logos. Thanks.
